## Deck Goal
Explain Causa's product value, evidence pipeline, causal RCA method, investigation workspace, guarded remediation model, and current production-readiness posture to engineering leaders, SRE teams, platform engineers, and technical evaluators.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Causa is an observability-driven root-cause analysis system for Kubernetes microservices. Alertmanager triggers a durable ingestion stage that scopes and snapshots Prometheus metrics, Tempo traces, Loki logs, topology, and infrastructure context. Stage 2 builds incident graphs, detects anomalies, isolates possible multi-fault incidents, ranks root-cause candidates, and persists explainable reports in Postgres. A React/FastAPI dashboard connects the RCA story to evidence, timelines, topology, related telemetry, feedback, and durable incident history. Remediation is proposal-first: typed plans pass through policy, human approval, leased workers, SLO observation, and rollback handling. Automatic execution remains blocked until calibration and operational readiness gates pass.",
    "core_claim": "Causa compresses the path from alert to accountable action by connecting cross-signal evidence, influence-aware causal ranking, an operator investigation workspace, and guarded remediation without hiding uncertainty.",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Causa",
      "Alertmanager",
      "causa-ingest",
      "Stage 2 RCA",
      "Influence Graph",
      "Prometheus",
      "Tempo",
      "Loki",
      "Postgres",
      "Guarded Remediation",
      "proposal-only"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Microservice failures propagate across synchronous calls, asynchronous dependencies, and infrastructure. A downstream symptom may be louder than the upstream cause. Operators must mentally connect separate telemetry tools while avoiding risky action based on weak or uncalibrated evidence."
  }
}
